text:
incident-bot: ALERT P1 — Kestrel Labs (vpc:kestrel-prod) — elevated toolcall/parser errors on /v1/toolcall, error rate spike 18% -> 68% in last 5m. Paging eng-oncall.
Marco: ack, i'm on it. seeing tons of JSON parse exceptions in toolcall workers.
Lina: i'm taking initial lead. Samir can you pull recent logs and sample payloads?
Samir: pulling now — looks like function response body changed shape. previously a dict with 'result' field, now sometimes comes back as a string or nested array. parser expects object -> throws. grabbing sample...
Samir: ```
# sample from kestrel-prod worker
REQ id=0x9f2f POST /v1/toolcall
body: {"tool_id":"weather","args":{...}}
RESP 200
tool_output: "[\"Sunny\", \"High 72\"]"  <-- unexpected stringified-array
error: parse_error at tool_response -> json.loads failed
stack: runtime/parser.py:87
```
Marco: ugh, stringified arrays. looks like customer tool started returning pre-serialized JSON (string) intermittently. parser code does strict type checks.
Elaine: that's the schema drift we feared. This customer has a dedicated pool dp-322, right?
Marco: yes dp-322 serving kestrel-prod. impact confined to that tenant but it's hitting production KPI for them.
Lina: immediate mitigation options: 1) route kestrel to a lenient parser shim that attempts json.loads if type==str 2) disable toolcall for kestrel (fast, more disruptive) 3) apply a runtime fix to parser to coerce string->json and deploy to dp-322 only. Thoughts?
Samir: option 1 or 3 preferred. 3 is more robust but needs a canary push to dp-322. 1 can be done in router layer in ~10m.
QA-Jordan: if we coerce blindly we might mask user-side bugs. need test harness.
Marco: can we do router-rule fallback first then roll a targeted hotfix? do we have ability to patch dp-322 without impacting other tenants?
Lina: yes, we can push config to route kestrel to 'parser-lenient' instance running on same pool. ops-bot can create a route rule.
ops-bot: creating route change: set routing rule kestrel-prod -> parser-lenient (dp-322) ; will take ~45s to propagate.
Marco: adding mitigation note to incident timeline. informing customer success (cc: CSM).
Samir: applying quick shim in REQ middleware as well to catch string outputs: ```
if isinstance(tool_response, str):
    try:
        tool_response = json.loads(tool_response)
    except Exception:
        raise
```
Lina: Samir, do that as a config toggle (parser.coerce_string_json=true) and enable for kestrel only. Samir: pushing config to dp-322 canary target now.
Samir: pushed. canary logs show initial success: stringified-array now parsed into list, no parse_error. error rate dropping.
incident-bot: Incident status update — mitigation applied (parser lenient shim, kestrel-only), error rate down to 2.3% from 68% in 12m.
Marco: good. Lina, do you want to take handoff and continue remediation windows? I'm going offline in 30m.
Lina: I'll take on-call. Samir, please draft a proper parser patch to handle both string and object responses with tests. Elaine, can you coordinate a customer-facing note?
Elaine: on it. I'll notify CSM and request that Kestrel confirm whether they deployed a change to their tool that could cause serialization.
QA-Jordan: filing regression test to cover stringified responses and add to nightly tests. ticket #INC-4921.
Samir: working on code change. will open PR with unit tests and a targeted rollout plan to dp-322. estimated 2h.
Marco: before Samir's PR lands, keep the lenient shim enabled. note: watch for any latency regression due to extra json.loads.
ops-bot: autoscaling notice — dp-322 currently at 65% utilization; will scale +1 replica if CPU > 75% for 2m.
Lina: monitoring latency and error budgets. setting alert threshold: toolcall error rate for kestrel > 5% -> page.
incident-bot: incident severity reduced to P2 per oncall after mitigation.
Samir: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/parser/merge_requests/1182 — patch coerces strings, adds schema validation, and includes canary job config.
Marco: nice. Once PR is merged, schedule a canary deploy to dp-322, then to other pools if safe.
Elaine: customer impact summary for CSM: some toolcall responses temporarily failing; fallbacks/bundled features degraded for Kestrel users between 09:13-09:32 UTC. No data exfiltration.
Lina: thanks. I'll keep monitoring and will post final resolution here. Samir, QA-Jordan — coordinate to verify post-deploy.
Samir: will coordinate and aim for deploy in 2 hours.
QA-Jordan: will run smoke tests and post results.
Marco: handing off to Lina. I'm out for the day, thx team :thumbsup:.
Lina: taking over. current status: mitigation active, error rate 0.9% last 5m, customer impact limited. Postmortem owner: Lina. Follow-ups: (1) permanent parser patch PR (Samir) (2) add e2e tests for tool responses (QA-Jordan) (3) reach out to Kestrel engineering to understand root cause (Elaine) (4) run a canary and rollback plan doc (Marco/Samir).
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigation verified). Timeline saved to /incidents/2123456789-kestrel-toolcall.json.
Lina: closing thread but will link postmortem when ready. thanks everyone.
